descriptions.rezumerAi: Rezumer AI is an AI-assisted resume builder for job seekers who want one workspace to draft, refine, tailor, and export resumes. It combines structured resume editing with AI-powered section optimization, job-description matching, and a scope-aware assistant that can answer public, account, or admin questions based on the current user's access.
descriptions.batibot: Batibot is an AI-powered messaging companion that helps you find the right information and services for your needs.
descriptions.zomink: Zomink is an open-source link management platform with all the features you need in one place. Manage, track, and shorten your URLs with your custom alias.
descriptions.sticaLms: STICA LMS is my college capstone project. It is an online library management system for STI College Alabang.
descriptions.kokuban: Kokuban helps teachers in Japan create online educational materials that their students can access and use in a browser.
descriptions.zomify: Zomify is a Spotify clone built with SvelteKit, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS.
descriptions.paymongo: A lightweight, full-featured, modular, TypeScript-compatible JavaScript library for PayMongo.
descriptions.groundwork: An online B2B platform designed to create and grow networks for businesses in the Philippines.
descriptions.zomifyColors: A color palette app inspired by Flat UI Colors.
